options.description: threat weight of Illegal Content Length Check

options.name: http2-max-requests
options.description: max number of requests in HTTP2 connection, default value is 1000 [0 ,65535]

options.name: max-cookie-in-request
options.description: max count of cookie request, default value is 128 [0,1023]

options.name: max-header-line-request
options.description: max count of header line request, default value is 64 [0,128]

options.name: max-http-body-length
options.description: max length (KB) of body, 0 means this value has not limitation

options.name: max-http-body-parameter-length
options.description: max length of body parameter, default value is 8192

options.name: max-http-content-length
options.description: max length (KB) of content, 0 means this value has not limitation

options.name: max-http-header-length
options.description: max length of header, default value is 8192

options.name: max-http-header-name-length
options.description: max length of header name, default value is 50

options.name: max-http-header-value-length
options.description: max length of header value, default value is 4096

options.name: max-http-request-filename-length
options.description: max length of request filename, default value is 2048

options.name: max-http-request-length
options.description: max length of http request, default value is 2048[0,65536] (KB)

options.name: max-setting-current-streams-num
options.description: max setting current streams number, default value is 256

options.name: max-setting-frame-size
options.description: max setting frame size, default value is 16384

options.name: max-setting-header-list-size
options.description: max setting header list size, default value is 65536

options.name: max-setting-header-table-size
options.description: max setting header table size, default value is 4096

options.name: max-setting-initial-window-size
options.description: max setting initial window size, default value is 6291456

options.name: max-url-param-name-len
options.description: max url parameter name length, default value is 4096

options.name: max-url-param-value-len
options.description: max url parameter value length, default value is 4096

options.name: max-url-parameter
options.description: max number of url parameter, default value is 128 [0,1023]

options.name: max-url-parameter-length
options.description: max length of url parameter, default value is 8192

options.name: number-of-ranges-in-range-header
options.description: max ranges in Range Header,default value is 5 [0 ,64]
